description: A 16:9 architecture diagram with three columns. Middle column, top to bottom: a green strip 'Sign-in: OAuth 2.1 token, the person's own session'; below it a large rounded sky-blue box 'Rasoi toolbox: MCP server' containing three small white chips 'tools', 'resources', 'prompts'; below it an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)' joined to the toolbox by one short vertical line. Left column: four host boxes stacked vertically with equal gaps, 'Ask Rasoi', 'Claude Desktop', 'VS Code and Cursor', 'n8n workflows'. All four arrows from the host boxes go to the LEFT EDGE OF THE SKY-BLUE TOOLBOX BOX, converging on it like a fan; no arrow goes to Bahi ERP; each arrow is labelled 'MCP'. Bahi ERP has no connection except the line to the toolbox above it. Right column: a dashed rectangle titled 'Deccan Polymers, another company' containing one box 'Deccan sales agent'. One curved sky-blue double-headed arrow goes from the top host box 'Ask Rasoi' over the top of the whole diagram to 'Deccan sales agent', labelled 'A2A'. Labels as plain text, no brackets except '(1998)'.
